description: This file is a shell script responsible for managing system logs, including archiving, merging, compressing, and uncompressing various log files such as system logs, event logs, and firewall logs. It also handles log folder creation, cleanup, and configuration related to syslog.

methods.name: old_sysevtlog_handle
methods.description: Handles the archival and compression of old system or event logs, including creating a temporary directory, copying logs, compressing them into tar.bz2 archive, and removing original files.

methods.name: old_fwlog_handle
methods.description: Merges old firewall logs, combines files, and manages their archiving as tar.bz2 files.

methods.name: createSystemAndEventLogFolder
methods.description: Creates necessary directories for system and event logs based on syslog configuration, setting up symlinks and permissions.

methods.name: get_log_file
methods.description: Retrieves the log file path for specified log types, with fallback to syslog.conf configuration.

methods.name: remove_log
methods.description: Removes specified log files or directories.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses logs of specified type (syslog, eventlog, fwlog), managing rotation, file size, and archival.

methods.name: uncompress
methods.description: Decompresses specified tar.bz2 archives into target directories.
